messages:
Sam (Sales): Quick handoff for Pendulum Health (mid-market). Signed last week; they want Redwood Dedicated to start a 90-day pilot. Key points: SSO via Okta not yet set, want private peering, heavy use of chat streaming for patient triage (avg 300 tokens/request), expect 3k req/day initially with spikes up to 9k/day. They asked for an estimated monthly run-rate and a short onboarding timeline. Also asked about data retention and HIPAA addendum. Can CS/SE/Support sync Tue 11am ET?

Ivy (CS): I'll take onboarding lead and weekly enablement. Tue 11am ET ok. Sam, please share primary contacts and the Okta metadata. I'll create CS-5003 and a runbook skeleton with milestones (provisioning, SSO, perf tuning, pilot go/no-go).

Diego (Solutions Eng): Diego here 9. I'll validate streaming latency and recommend quant/batching for cost. Sam, can you drop a sanitized sample conversation and an example tps during peak? I'll run a quick bench and post recommended settings by Wed EOD. Example bench we ask them to run: ```curl -s -X POST https://bench.redwood.internal/run -d '{"model":"chat-large","seq":300,"requests":200}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'```

Nora (Support): I'll prepare the private peering checklist (IP allowlist, certs, egress rules) and admin SSO steps for the console. Tagging infra-oncall for routing.

legal-bot: HIPAA request logged LEG-3021. Notifying Legal.

Ivy (CS): Owners: Sam = sales contact, Ivy = CS onboarding lead (CS-5003), Diego = SE for perf & SSO proof, Nora = Support for network & ops, Legal picked up LEG-3021. Next steps on CS-5003: 1) Sam share Okta metadata + contacts; 2) Diego to run perf bench and advise quant/batching; 3) Nora to publish network checklist and preflight; 4) Ivy to send invite for Tue 11am ET and draft enablement deck with cost/run-rate estimate.

Sam (Sales): Shared contacts + 1Password vault link for test creds. Procurement wants a line-item monthly estimate and a simple pilot checklist to sign off. Flagging renewal risk: medium if pilot costs exceed their budget.

Diego (Solutions Eng): Running bench now. Initial p50 streaming ~260ms in region, recommend batch size=8 for streaming and 8-bit quant for non-critical routes to save ~25% on token cost. Will post full numbers to CS-5003.

Nora (Support): Network notes: allowlist 18.197.23.8/32 and 18.197.23.9/32, ports 443 and 8443, provide Okta SAML cert to setup SSO. Checklist added to CS-5003.

Ivy (CS): Invite sent, ticket created, owners assigned. I'll capture feedback during weekly enablement and escalate any regression to Product. Report back after Tue sync. :thumbsup:

Sam (Sales): Thanks team — I'll be on the call to intro procurement and the technical contact.

Diego (Solutions Eng): +1

Nora (Support): +1
